findings.issue: Game manuscript could cross provider transport after authorization revocation
findings.fix: Freeze game/token/authority in a single-use body and retain existing game SQL locks through transport consumption; release before generation
regression: consent and source revocation before send produce zero transmitted bytes
authorized send stages the real validated candidate
revocation waits on the actual database lock during send, then finishes before the provider response

findings.issue: Multi-call photo message citations could borrow the first search receipt
findings.fix: Use each native call source list; message citation fallback requires exactly one observed search call
regression: persisted later-call photo keeps its own discovery receipt
unbound citations are excluded with completed or incomplete sibling calls

findings.issue: A case outside the requested phase could produce a zero-case passed evaluation
findings.fix: Reject phase/case mismatches before allocation and mark empty execution incomplete
regression: both phase mismatch directions in plan and execute modes

findings.issue: Game dialog and requests survived Back/Forward while another interview recovered
findings.fix: Close on popstate/pagehide and abort dialog-owned requests/listeners
regression: actual Back and Forward immediately close and abort before held recovery returns
failed recovery and late stale responses cannot restore the old dialog

findings.issue: Keyboard Walk activation could not move after NPC dialogue
findings.fix: Clear dialogue on Enter/Space movement just as pointer/arrow movement does
regression: Enter and Space on directional controls in English desktop and Chinese phone flows
